text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: ——Air Groove trails by about four lengths! Surging from mid-pack, Air Groove unleashes her burst!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes, right there! Look closely right here! The runners inside begin drifting outward to seal her line, so she instantly pivots wide...!
choice_data_list: She accelerated and passed them instantly!
She accelerated and passed them instantly!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes, she did! A split-second gamble despite conceding extra ground! I want to run with that kind of fearless brilliance too——!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I knew you would understand, Trainer-san! Um, shall we watch another one together? Like this one here...!
choice_data_list: Yeah! I remember this race too――
Yeah! I remember this race too――

text_block_list.text: Rhein Kraft and I spent hours passionately dissecting the races of Tiara Umamusume. Her eyes sparkled relentlessly the entire time——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I want to become just like them——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I want to leave my mark. To reach their heights. To become part of that lineage, that is my true desire.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: At first... it began as a faint impulse. Deep in a cabinet at home sat an old race tape. I believe it recorded the "Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks)".

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume racing were so graceful and magnificent. Witnessing their triumph utterly captivated me... sparking my love for racing.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: After begging my parents endlessly, they took me to watch my very first live race, the "Japanese Oaks"——and right then!

text_block_list.name: Young Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Huh? How strange... this is my first live race... yet I recognize that running form! That gorgeous stride——!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: When I looked it up later, the truth clicked. That Umamusume was the very idol I admired on those old tapes... It felt as though she imparted her legacy directly to me.

text_block_list.name: Oaks Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: Thank you all so much for cheering for me! This victory... belongs entirely to the guidance of my mentor.

text_block_list.name: Oaks Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: I will continue running the Tiara circuit so that one day, I can guide others just like my teacher. Passing forward what I learned, serving as that bridge—that is the runner I strive to be.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Just as the "Queen" mother connects directly to the "Empress" Air Groove, it flows like that, right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Like Tiara Umamusume passing a shared baton down generation after generation... they pass it onward, forged in unbreakable bonds.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Compared to Triple Crown Umamusume who etch grand legends across an era, it might appear subtle. Even so——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: As seniors, as leaders, and as maternal figures, Tiara Umamusume have always built that sacred bridge with their own hands.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: From trailblazers of the past to those who follow behind. Passing along that baton steeped in emotion, ready to be seized anew.
choice_data_list: An inheritance from the Tiara Uma Musume……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't that truly magnificent? That conviction took root in my soul.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I want to carry that torch too. I want my stride to reach someone out there, to build that connection——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: So that whenever the next runner arrives, my path will serve as the legacy left behind for her.
choice_data_list: That's why you want the Tiara rotation
That's why you want the Tiara rotation

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes. Those seniors, and all of us, are undeniably powerful. Therefore——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: There are sights only a Tiara Umamusume can reveal. And truths only we can convey to the world!
Steadfast and pure... unchanged since day one. Hearing her resolute vow——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eh? Trainer-san——
choice_data_list: I can almost see it already
I can almost see it already

text_block_list.text: I spoke from the heart. She needed to know. I had to tell her... How gloriously she would bloom if she pursued her dream without compromise.
choice_data_list: Can I help with your training?
Can I help with your training?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Gladly! I will give everything I have in the Debut Selection Race!
We clasped hands beneath the canopy of stars——and thus, our shared journey of training with Rhein Kraft commenced.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...! Full sprint set finished~~~...! Next up... light recovery jogging...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Haa, huu, huu, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huu, huu, grrr~~~...! Hnnnnnnnn...!
choice_data_list: Don't let your knees move so far foward!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaa—————————!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text: Incredible~ Rhein Kraft's training menu is absurd again today! She must be taking this Debut Selection Race super seriously...!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text: Well, maybe? But our queen has zero chance of losing. Right? She can't hold a candle to you, Heart!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Who knows? Truthfully told, at this pace she holds the advantage. Rhein Kraft is no opponent to be taken lightly.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text: Wait, for real? Even you find her daunting, Heart...? Then, then——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That only holds "if I remain stagnant as I am now." ...Fabulous, isn't it? My blood is boiling!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Between now and race day, I simply must elevate my own caliber. The true queen's crown yields to nobody!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Daring Heart-san appears to be altering her training regimen. How much will she develop before the race? ...My calculations require revision.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Still, I cannot afford distraction. Whatever path others take……my purpose remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: My mother's strength, and legacy entrusted to me—I will prove it all. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: For that, I must make steady, definite progress. Step by step, growing stronger……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm baaack—. Phew, completely wiped out today too~……

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah, sorry I'm late! Let's hit cafeteria～……wait, huh? Cesario, still in focus mode?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: So strict and stoic! Totally locked in……thought you'd be in relaxing off-mode back in dorm.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Phew……――indeed. Usually, yes.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yet now is no time to let guard down. Forgive me, but please eat ahead. I intend to run more.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ……Craft, have you noticed lately? Everyone around us is being moved by your presence.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh, by me……?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes. Your pure devotion toward Triple Tiara……spurs everyone forward. ――Myself included.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yet when it comes to that passion, and strength……I will not yield, Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I too seek Triple Tiara glory. I too shall carve my name into Tiara history――

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: One day, I shall become foundation of that legacy. Thus……defeat here is unthinkable.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: First comes Debut Selection. Consider this declaration of war, Rhein Kraft――!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Cesario……! ……Yeah! I won't lose either!
